# Benesse 40S404 (i.MX6Q "bee01") proprietary blobs.
# Extracted directly from the stock /system on the real unit (SN <40S404-twrp-serial>),
# 2026-10-01, via adb pull with root. See ../twrp-build-40s404.md (sibling
# TWRP project) for how these were identified.

# GPU (Vivante GC350)
lib/libGAL.so
lib/libGLES_trace.so
lib/libjni_eglfence.so
# Vivante GLSL shader compiler: dlopen'd by libGLESv2_VIVANTE. Without it every
# glCompileShader fails silently, so HWUI (GLES2) renders nothing -> blank UI.
lib/libGLSLC.so
# 2D GPU (used by hwcomposer_viv) and ION wrapper
lib/libg2d.so
lib/libion.so
egl/libEGL_VIVANTE.so
egl/libGLES_android.so
egl/libGLESv1_CM_VIVANTE.so
egl/libGLESv2_VIVANTE.so
egl/egl.cfg

# Audio HAL
hw/audio.primary.imx6.so
hw/audio.a2dp.default.so
hw/audio.r_submix.default.so
hw/audio.usb.default.so
hw/audio_policy.default.so

# Camera, display, sensors, power, lights HALs
hw/camera.imx6.so
hw/gralloc.imx6.so
hw/gralloc_viv.imx6.so
hw/hwcomposer.imx6.so
hw/hwcomposer_viv.imx6.so
hw/lights.imx6.so
hw/power.imx6.so
hw/sensors.SABRESD.so

# WiFi (Marvell sd8787, SDIO) -- out-of-tree kernel modules, no source in the
# GPL kernel dump. Must be loaded against the EXACT kernel ABI they were
# built for -- this device tree reuses the stock kernel verbatim (same
# strategy as the TWRP port) specifically so these keep working unmodified.
etc/wifi/mlan.ko
etc/wifi/sd8787.ko
etc/wifi/wpa_supplicant.conf
etc/firmware/mrvl/sd8787_uapsta.bin

# WiFi bring-up helpers invoked by init.freescale.rc services (mlan_init,
# wifi_reset, cp_calib, mlan2040coex). Pulled from the stock backup tar.
bin/mlaninit.sh
bin/mlanutl
bin/mlan2040coex
bin/set_macaddr
bin/wifi_reset.sh
bin/copy_calib.sh

# Audio routing / media profiles (stock). media_codecs.xml is NOT taken: it lists
# Freescale OMX/VPU components (lib_omx_*, libvpu) that are not ported yet.
etc/audio_policy.conf
etc/media_profiles.xml
